name: Gemini Code Assist
verification_override: Pricing page at cloud.google.com/products/gemini/pricing truncates mid-page on fetch. When the fetch is incomplete, cross-check feature claims against https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/overview and the pricing FAQ. Standard and Enterprise show monthly + 12-month commitment prices side by side — preserve the existing 'Annual billing: $X/mo' format in notes if present. If per-day request limits aren't extractable, log an extraction_failure rather than infer.

includes.notes: Free for individuals. 6,000 code completions and 240 chat requests/day. 1,000 CLI/Agent mode requests/day. No credit card required. Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers get higher daily limits.
1,500 CLI/Agent mode requests/day. 30-day free trial (up to 50 users). 12-month commitment: $19.00/user/month.
2,000 CLI/Agent mode requests/day, code customization from GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket repos, VPC-SC, audit logs, CMEK. 30-day free trial (up to 50 users). 12-month commitment: $45.00/user/month.
